cirāya paridṛṣṭo'si śiṣye mayi dayāṃ kuru
purā vidhiḥ prārthito'pi mayā bhūyaḥ svayaṃ jagau
pratīkṣa kālaṃ kālena vinā no sidhyatīhitam
na taṃ kālaṃ prapaśyāmi leśato'pi sukhāvaham
eṣa kuñjaḥ kaṇṭakitaḥ svargo nandanameva ca
vinā guruṃ trimūrtibhyaḥ patitāḥ sarva eva te
daṇḍavat praṇatā bhūtvā jaya devīti tāṃ jaguḥ
sa ca lokānāṃ tvamiva maheśvari ! līlādraṣṭā nandati devaḥ
atha tān prāha paramā vatsā uttiṣṭhata drutam
śrutvaivaṃ dhātṛmukhyānāṃ vacaḥ sā prāha śaṅkarī
atha bhūyo'pi bahudhā prārthayāmāsa tāṃ guruḥ
yadi māmīdṛśīṃ śakraḥ paśyettacchṛṇu vacmi te
darśayiṣyāmi tasmai svamidaṃ rūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
evaṃ tasyā'rādhayato māsāḥ ṣaṭ pañca cā'tyayuḥ
rājyaṃ tribhuvane prāpya striyā vinihato balī
hatau yuddhe caṇḍikayā sabalāviti naḥ śrutam
sa yadāha na cā'lpaṃ tadvidhi daityagaṇeśvara !
atra me'bhimataṃ rājan śṛṇu buddhyā vicāritam
iti te'bhihito mantro nā'taḥ kṣemaṃ bhavet kvacit
eṣa bālastava bhujabalaṃ no vetti kiñcana
na khaḍgadhārāṃ jānanti na śūrāḥ śarasaṃstṛtau
yoṣidvā puruṣo vāpi nopekṣyaḥ śatrutāṃ gataḥ
vatsa ! kiṃ yuddhavārtābhireva bhīto'si vai mudhā
gaccha jvālāmālini tvaṃ rakṣa bhītān surān drutam
avasat saparīvārā yathā loke svake tathā
kīdṛśaṃ kiṃ pramāṇañca yasmin vasati sā parā
ye ca pādabhavā devāḥ sadā sevanatatparāḥ
taddhetuṃ te pravakṣyāmi na tajjānāti kaścana
vidyā ṛṣitvaṃ samprāptā tannāmnā sā sphuṭaṅgatā
tato me niyaterbhaṅga eva nā'rhasi samprati
śrīcakraṃ me bhaveccakraṃ śrīkramaḥ syānmama kramaḥ
yadyattava priyaṃ loke tanmamā'pi priyaṃ bhavet
pūjā'śaktau kevalaṃ vā sūktante yaḥ paṭhet sadā
sā pūjā syānmahāpūjā prasannā'haṃ tato drutam
iti dattvā varaṃ tasyai ramāyai tripurā parā
atha vakṣye śrīpurasya vṛttaṃ lokottaraṃ śṛṇu
yadā sā paramā devī prārthitā vidhimukhyakaiḥ
bhagavanna mayā jñātaṃ tatpuraṃ kutra saṃsthitam
etanme śaṃsa bhagavan vidhāsye'haṃ niśamya tat
tato vajramayaḥ sālastatra vajrā nadī sthitā
tatra somaḥ sthito rājā kiraṃstatra sudhāṃ'śubhiḥ
hṛdi tat paripṛcchāmi vaktuṃ tanme tvamarhasi
na gatistatra cā'nyeṣāṃ guṇajebhya iti śrutam
kathametat sthitaṃ deva kṛpāṃ kuru mayīśvara
tatkṛpāṃ kuru deveśi ! na ramāmo'tra karmasu
ityasmadīritaṃ śrutvā prāha sā tripurā parā
kalpitaṃ vividhaṃ sāraṃ sparśācchīrṇa babhau kṣaṇāt
tadicchayaiva turyaśca tau tāṃ devīṃ praṇematuḥ
dadhyau sadāśivaḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ tasyāḥ kṣṇādatha
sadāśivā īśvarāśca tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ eva ca
praṇamya prāha tāṃ devīṃ siddhamamba! samāruha
sadāśivo'pi yuktaṃ tanmatvā cakre gṛhaṃ śubham
ṛte sambhavate vallī taruhīnā yathā bhuvi
na sannā'sadabhinnaṃ vā vibhinnaṃ kimapi hyabhūt
dṛṣṭvaikalāṃ tvāṃ na vayaṃ hṛṣyāmo'titarāṃ śive
omityuktvā ca sā devī śakticakraṃ mahā'dbhutam
nṛpasaṃkyā nāma tāsāṃ rūpaṃ sthānañca me vada
sṛṣṭaṃ śrītripurāśaktyā kutra kāḥ śaktyaḥ sthitā
iti pṛṣṭo viśvakṛtā prītaḥ prāha caturmukhaḥ
prakalpya sthānamevaṃ sā vṛttabhūmau svayaṃ sthitā
kaumārī vaiṣṇavī vaiṣṇavī vārāhī māhendrī tataḥ param
sammohinī stambhinī ca jṛmbhiṇī ca vaśaṅkarī
tathā'ṣṭā're trikoṇe ca kutaḥ sthānaṃ viśaktikam
ityuktvā tapa evaoccaiścakruḥ prāk śaktibhiḥ saha
triṇetrāśca tapasyeva ratā dṛṣṭvā ca pūrvajāḥ
tapasyeva ratāstāśca dṛṣṭvā śaktīḥ puraḥ sthitāḥ
prāptā ca parayā tatra sāyujyaṃ ṣoḍaśī parā
svayantu pañcamī bhūtvā tāsāṃ tuṣṭā samāsthitā
madhyaṃ sthānaṃ dadau devī prasannā parisevanāt
kāmeśvarī ca vajreśī bhagamālinikā ca yā
vāme ca dakṣiṇe pārśve sthānaṃ devyabhikalpayat
evaṃ navasu cakreṣu vibhatya vinive ya ca
kāmeśa bhagavan deva tvamapi sṛja svāṃ'śataḥ
iti te pṛṣṭamākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahat
tatra kuṇḍe bhavadbhiśca strīrūpā kena hetunā
pārvatīṃ sarvato guptāṃ prasannaḥ prabruve tava
na cetayanti te bhūtaṃ bhavyañca kvacidātmani
brahmāṇḍeṣu sthitā devā daityā martyādayo'pi ye
te tatra tattatsthāneṣu nivasanti pṛthak pṛthak
punaḥ śrotuṃ samīhā me vardhate'titarāṃ nanu
kṛpayā paśya śiṣyaṃ te durlabhaṃ te kṛpekṣaṇam
prāyo viprā bhīravo hi gururme bhayamohitaḥ
devāḥ śaktimupāsīnāḥ prasannā yadi sā bhavet
hṛṣṭaḥ pratyāgataḥ sthānaṃ tatra pṛcchāmi prastutam
prabhāṣase kathaṃ mugdha iva tvaṃ paṇḍito'pi san
sameṣyati tvāṃ nihantuṃ kiṃ tuṣyasi hi mūḍhavat
daityeśvara ! maduktaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu vākyaṃ sudhāsamam
na kiṃ smarasi gauryā te yuddhe pūrvaparābhavam
yasya prasādādeva tvaṃ manyase balināṃ varam
ahaṃ tvāṃ tatra neṣyāmi parāśakteḥ padāntikam
rājyaṃ prasādhi pātāle divaṃ śāsatu vāsavaḥ
na kariṣyasi matproktaṃ yadā yahi vinaṅkṣyasi
devarṣamayi roṣaṃ tvaṃ na śiṣye kartumarhasi
jānāsi sarvaṃ me vṛttaṃ līlayaivaṃ bravīṣi mām
śrutvā madviparītoktiṃ sādhvī sā kinnarī vacaḥ
āste tasya priyā cā'smi tarucchāyeva saṅgatā
tvaṃ te sutā dharmato'haṃ naivaṃ māṃ vaktumarhasi
nāśayettaṃ manaḥ śīghraṃ mano yasya vaśe na hi
strīsukhaṃ sarvato hyekaṃ na viśeṣaḥ paśuṣvapi
patibratānāṃ krodhāgniṃ prāpya mā bhasmatāṃ vrajāḥ
athaṣṭvā'nayaṃ devī ramā kruddhā śaśāpa mām
punaḥ prāha ramādevī māṃ magnaṃ śokasāgare
evaṃ tayā praśapto'haṃ bhīto devīśriyaṃ tadā
nā'nyathā me bhavecchāpaḥ kṛtaṃ bhoktavyameva te
sā kiṃ tvatto'dhikā devī nā'haṃ jāne tavā'dhikām
dve kale tasya nāthasya kāryatā kartṛteti ca
kartṛtā syāt saptadaśī kalā nityā maheśituḥ
tāṃ hitvā na śivaḥkaścit brahmā vā'pi sadāśivaḥ
nara nāryaḥ prāṇijātaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā
ityuktastu tayā paścāt prārthanaṃ kṛtavān punaḥ
na jātu māmiyaṃ prajñā jahātu jagadambike !
talloke nivasāmyāśu iti me tvarte manaḥ
atha devaiḥ prārthitā sā lalitā parameśvarī
ajñātvā madbalaṃ mugdhā vināśaṃ mā vrajā'dhunā
manye'haṃ tvaṃ jitaprāyā tena dhīreṇa sāmpratam
pṛccha nārada ! praṣṭavyaṃ yatte manasi vidyate
devī! bhaṇḍāsuro dṛṣṭo mayā samyak parīkṣitaḥ
ciraṃ nivasya śrīloke tato gacchāmi tatpadam
śṛṇu me nārda ! vaco rahasyamapi sāmpratam
taṃ bhaktaśekharaṃ hatvā duṣkṛtaṃ vitataṃ kṛtam
tasmai tattripurā śighraṃ prayachati na saṃśayaḥ
ajñasya tatsamīhā syāt jñasya vai tatkuto bhavet
ākāśasyeva pūrṇasya kiṃ prāptiḥ syāt kathaṃvada ?
atha sā tripurā devī bhaṇḍā'suravadhaṃ prati
śastrāṇyastrāṇi ca tathā mūrtimanti sthitāni vai
śoṇāḥ śyāmāḥ sitāḥ pītāḥ kapilāḥ pāṭalāstathā
nūnaṃ hīme mama kṛte vinaśyanti sabāndhavāḥ
athaivaṃ mayi nirtya prāpte devyā nijā'tyayam
kathaṃ mayi hate devatrāsanā mama bāndhavā
bhaviṣyanti śucā hīnā na caitadapi sammatam
atrā'pi manye strībālamukhānāṃ n hi sambhavam
iti tanme parīvāraṃ na śoṣayatu sā parā
na me mṛyuḥ kuto'pyasti mṛtyormṛtyurahaṃ yatha
tadantre tu vijayaḥ prāpya daityeśvaraṃ drutam
so'pi tvatsammukhaṃ prāpya yudde bhūyaḥ parājitaḥ
vijñaptavyamidaṃ kāle mayā te svāminaḥ puraḥ
nā'haṃ tvāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ sarvathā saṃśrayocitām
yuddhaśraddhā taveyaṃ vai sammtaṃ mama sarvathā
kintvahaṃ tvāṃ priyākārāṃ dṛṣṭvā drutaṃ manobhavām
balañcasarvaṃ tatkṛtyaṃ jñatvāa yāhi druta punaḥ
nītvā papraccha dūtaṃ taṃ kṛtyaṃ tatrā'gamasya hi
mābhairdaitya vraja sukhaṃ hanyase na kadācana
yadi te jīvane śraddhā drutamāgatya nirbhayaḥ
anyathā na vimokṣaste jīvan kvā'pi bhaviṣyati
aśaktaḥ spanditumapi kva yuddhaṃ kva palāyanam
sā senā mahatī dṛṣṭā bhīmā bhīṣaṇanādinī
bhaṇḍaputrān nihanmīti sā bravīti punaḥ punaḥ
na me vīryaṃ balaṃ vāpi babhau śaktyagrataḥ kvacit
brūyāstaṃ bhaṇḍadaityeśaṃ jīvane yadi te matiḥ
akṛtvaivaṃ na te mokṣo lokā'ntaragatasya ca
iti tvayā tatra gatvā vaktvyo bhaṇdadānavaḥ
madbhṛtyāḥ śaktyo gatvā dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ samāgatāḥ
yattvayā'pyatra no jñātaṃ tattvayā kathitaṃ nanu
ta eva bhogāstadrājyaṃ tāḥ striyastaśca saṅgatam
parantu me virahitāḥ śociṣyanti priyā eme
evaṃ me tripurā devī kṛpāṃ kuryādabhīpsitām
paśyantu daityā ye bhītāḥ tasyāmeti parākramam
putrāḥ pautrāśca bhrātaraḥ sarvaḥ eva te
kiṃ vadāmi punargatvā tāṃ devīṃ gajavāhinīm
lakṣaye sarvacihnāni kintveṣā taruṇī na ca
viśukro vā viṣaṅgo vā rājā vā'ṣyahameva vā
atha bālā prāha sakhīṃ rathanetrīṃ smitā'nanā
ityuktā rathanetrī sā bālāṃ proce sakhī tadā
śastreṇa sṛja mārgaṃ tvaṃ vāhayāmi tato ratham
ashyāṃ śaradhārāṃ tāṃ prāpya daityāḥ pradudruvuḥ
hā tāta putra susakhe bhrātarmitra hato'smyaham
kiṃ kariṣyati sā devī lalitā samare punaḥ
kiṃ vakṣyatha gṛhe stribhiḥ pṛṣṭā yudhānnivartane
atha tāṃ rathanetrīṃ sā sakhī prāha priyaṃvadā
paryāptā me daityasenā yudhyantyā yudhi me dvacit
prāha śighraṃ naya rathaṃ yatrā'sau gajasaṃśrayaḥ
indrāyudhaṃ girimiva dadāra sa śaro gajam
jahi vīryeṇa daiteyaṃ yāvaddūraṃ na gacchati
avaśyaṃ mama yuddhasya vihatiṃ sā kariṣyati
utkaṇṭhitā'smi tadyuddhe sarvathā naya māṃ drutam
priye! bhaṇḍena yoddhavye mahān vighno hyupasthitaḥ
tadadbhutaṃ karma dṛṣṭvā daityā devāśca vismitāḥ
itthaṃ vicintya saśaraṃ jagrāha sudṛḍhaṃ dhanuḥ
sa śaraḥ pañcaśākhātmā pasparśa tasya mūrdhani
tasya sārpaṃ tasya punarnākulaṃ tasya caiva hi
alaṃ bāle sāhasena yuddhena viṣameṇa te
yuddhvā tenā'pi suciraṃ jitamāyaṃ cakāra vai
anyathā sā'pi madyuddhaṃ vimadā prāpya vai bhavet
maivaṃ vatse ! punabrūryā ityuktvā sāntvayat parā
krandantaḥ putra mitreti hā bhrātastāta ityapi
sasarja māyayā dhvāntaṃ tatra varṣa śilāmayam
tameva vāhanaṃ tasyā sampatkaryā yuyodha ha
mūrdhni tasya viśukrasya ruṣā sampatakarī balāt
baddhvā pāśena gadayā sā'śvaṃ hantuṃ samudyatā
nūnaṃ proktaṃ ramādevyā yat purā na tadanyathā
atha gatvā tayā sārdhaṃ mahārājñīṃ praṇamya ca
brūyurnātha kimadya tvāṃ paśyāmaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ yathā
prāha patnivacaḥ śrutvā jñātvā svā'bhimataṃ śubham
abhavat prakaṭstāsu priyāḥ śṛṇuta me vacaḥ
viditaṃ te nāradokteḥ sarvaṃ me samabhīpsitam
yadi te niścyo yuddhe hatā yāsyāmaḥ tatsthitam
tatte mārgaḥ pravidito vadā'smākaṃ kathaṃ gatiḥ
na bhavedanyathā hyetat sarvathā kāranam bruve
diśatyasādhyamapi ca tato naḥ syāt samīhitam
nūnaṃ loke suhṛdbandhuvaidhuryaṃ jātu vai kṣaṇam
etāvat prārthyate nūnaṃ na bhavet sakṣaṇaḥ kvacit
yasya yuddhe viṣṇumukhā yūyo jātāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ
yuvarāja kimevaṃ tvaṃ bravīṣi mayi jīvati
vadanto hā hatāsmeti tvaktvā yuddhaṃ vidudruvuḥ
tvāṃ nihatya raṇe paścānmukta syāṃ bhrātṛdoṣataḥ
atha daityo'pi khaḍgena tasyāḥ khaḍgaṃ dvidhā'karot
evaṃ kuraṇḍaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā senā'dhipo ruṣā
yutā gatvā drutaṃ hatvā baddhvā tāṃ vāraṇe drutam
tābhyāṃ bhagnā yudhi tadā karaṅkādyā mahāsurāḥ
taiḥ sarpairnihatā daṣṭā baddhā bhasmīkṛtā parā
devyau te śaravarṣeṇa sarpān ghanntyau muhurmuhaḥ
te sṛṣṭā nakulāḥ śīghraṃ tān sarpān sarvataḥ sthitān
aho ! kiṃ na bhavelloke viparīte vidhau nanu
tadvadā'śu kiṃ nimittaṃ samaṃ sarva karomyaham
vinā yuktyā na jīyeta mahābalavatā paraḥ
ahaṃ manye hatāḥ śaktigaṇā ityeva yuktitaḥ
kūṭenaiva vijeyā sā tatkrmaṃ niścitaṃ bruve
tasyā rathaṃ samāruhya tatratyā api kāścana
prahṛṣṭa utthāya ca taṃ taṃ drutaṃ sa pariṣasvaje
taṃ bhīmaṃ lokadalanaṃ śrutvā daityā mahāsvanam
tapasā bhavatāṃ netre sūryaḥ svāṃ'śaṃ dadau kila
mantriṇīṃ daṇḍinīṃ tyaktvā sarvaṃ śaktigaṇaṃ yadā
āgatya mantriṇīṃ natvā prāha kiṃ saṃsmṛteti vai
āliṅgya te kṛtaṃ kṛtyamasādhyaṃ sarvathā tvayā
evaṃ mahattare tatra sammrdda sati vaiśase
antaṃ madhyamathā'diṃ vā senāyāḥ ke'pi no viduḥ
yuddhdhvā ciraṃ hayāruḍhā baddhvā pāśena tān kramāt
sampannāthā'pi tairyuddhvā bhūyo bhallena tān kramāt
yuddhvaivaṃ mantribhiḥ sā'pi kruddhā khaḍgena pātayat
punaḥ prajñāṃ prāpya ruṣā dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ puraḥ sthitam
evaṃvidhāṃ śaktigaṇā dṛṣṭvā hā heti cukruśuḥ
utthitā jambhinī bhūyo dṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ nijaṃ dhanuḥ
matvā rathaṃ saṅkucitaṃ bhūmau tābhyām bhūt kṛtam
hataṃ vīkṣya camūnāthaṃ daityā bhītāḥ palāyitāḥ
evaṃ yuddhe parībhūto viśukro manyunā jvalan
viśukraṃ mūrcchitaṃ daityāḥ samādāya puraṃ yayuḥ
jetuṃ śakyeti saṃhṛṣṭo yayau tatrā'suro drutam
mūrcchitāḥ śaktayaḥ kāścita kāścit prāṇān jahuḥ parāḥ
evaṃ tābhirhanyamānā daityāḥ krodhaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ
vidrutā daityasubhaṭāḥ śiṣṭā bhītyā diśo daśa
kiṃ katthasi vṛthā duṣṭe hitvā lajjāṃ sudūrataḥ
hatvā vo lalitāṃ devī baddhvā jīvagraheṇa vai
striṣu kāruṇikatvaṃ me sarvathā tena vai ciram
tacchrautvā prāha nityā'dyā evaṃ cedastu vai raṇaḥ
ityuktvā deaityarājaṃ taṃ prāha bhūyo maheśvarī
ahamenaṃ yodhayāmi yūyamenaṃ n hi yūyamenaṃ hi rakṣatha
ahaṃ tvāṃ nava hiṃsyāmi kuryāṃ tvāṃ hi palāyatam
ityuktvā niśitān bhallān dehe tasya samākṣipat
kiṃ dayā te sumahatī jātaḥ kasmānnirāyudhaḥ
ruddho'tha sarvato mārge māyāṃ daityo vitānayat
vadho na yukto baddhasya mṛtatulyo hi sa smṛtaḥ
ityuktvā mocayāmāsa prāha taṃ mantriṇī tadā
akośe senayā hīne ratha eṣa tavā'śrayaḥ
na svasthahṛdayā bhūyo viśrāmaṃ nopayanti vai
atha sā tithirnityāsu yā tatrā'sti caturdaśī
papraccha vatsa kiṃ te'dya paśyāmi malinaṃ mukham
tat kiṃ karomi nāsīnme mṛtyuryuddheṣu sarvathā
na tai'svātmā parībhūto dṛṣto duḥkhāya kutracit
bhrātaḥ kiṃ bahunoktena sāraṃśṛṇu vadāmi te
gacchanhi pādavān bhūmau divā'pi skhalati kvacit
purā bhūyo vismṛtaṃ te tadahaṃ śṛṇu yadbrū ve
aghṛṣyaṃ taṃ samālakṣya dvāre śaktigaṇaṃ tathā
niryayuḥ sarvaḥ evaite daityā yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ
dṛṣṭvā'praghṛṣyantaṃ sālaṃ bhettuṃ te mana ādadhuḥ
vāyavyaṃ pārvataṃ cāndraṃ śaiśiraṃ pārthivaṃ tathā
na noparāddhaṃ daiteyaiḥ kathaṃ tairvigraho mataḥ
bālāyāḥ ko vicāraḥ syāt krīḍāsaktā hi sā sadā
na yudhyāmo vayaṃ vyarthaṃ tavā'jñāyāṃ na ca sthitāḥ
tatrocuranyāḥ saṃkruddhāḥ śūkarāsye sadā hi naḥ
iti matvā drutaṃ gatvā mantriṇyai tannivedayat
evaṃ tayā samājñapto gaṇeśo dhūnayan karam
evaṃ viśukraṃ nirjitya yayau bhaṇḍarathaṃ prati
nūnameṣa purā yuddhaṃ cakre yena mahaujasā
bālā praṇamya lalitāṃ prāha mañjulayā girā
pādau mūrdhnā spṛśāmyeṣā dehyajñāṃ samarāya me
kumāri ! śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yadi tvaṃ yoddhumicchasi
ekena saha yudhyasva daṇḍinyā ca mayā saha
ekena yudhyasva raṇe devyādiṣṭe kathaṃ tvayā
ekena teṣu yudhyasva yena yoddhuṃ samīpsitam
yadi yuddhe punarvighnaṃ kariṣyati tadā śṛṇu
evaṃ vadantīṃ bālāṃ tāṃ matvā ruṣṭāñca otriṇī
devi śaṅkāṃtyaja mayi āgacchāmi tvayā saha
iti śrutvā daṇḍinīṃ sā modādāśliṣya satvaram
drutaṃ vīryaṃ darśya te pa"ya me'dya parākramam
evaṃ te nāśitā daityā daityasṛṣṭā gajānanaiḥ
taṃ tato bāhubandhena baddhā daityaṃ nipātayat
evaṃ vidārito daityo jahau prāṇāṃstadā raṇe
praṇamya prāha mātaḥ kiṃ smṛto yuddhavidhau sthitaḥ
tān sayakaiḥ kirantī sā bālā yuddhe samāsadat
śṛṇudhvaṃ śaktyaḥ sarvā bālāmbājñāṃ bravīmi vaḥ
prayoktavyaṃ śastragaṇaṃ daṇḍyā sā me'nyathā bhavet
iti saṅghoṣya senāsu mantriṇyā sahitā svayam
atha śrutvā daṇḍarājñyāḥ śāsanaṃ muditā hi sā
vināśya tāṃ śastravṛṣiṃ bhūyaḥ sarvān jaghāna ha
na tatra daityaḥ śūro'pi kaścit svātmā'vane vibhuḥ
hā hatāḥsmo na ceyaṃ vai yoṣidbālā kumārikā
adya niḥśeṣitaṃ sainyaṃ daityānāṃ bhavati kṣaṇāt
evaṃ tadā daityasainyaṃ prāyo naṣṭaṃ palāyitam
devi nūnaṃ sā kumārī na śeṣayitumarhati
prāhare bhaṇḍadāyādāḥ śūrāṇāṃ vaḥ kathaṃ tvidam
tat paśya sadyastvāṃ kurmo vimadāṃ tat stharībhava
aho me vipulo mohaḥ smṛtibhraṃśaḥ samudgataḥ
yathā prārthitaṃ me tattathaiva kṛtaṃ tathā
yāntu pañcatvamatha vai tayā devyā raṇe hatāḥ
iti me prāgvyavasitaṃ prārthitā ca parāmbikā
cakre tatra mahāmoho vṛthā kiṃ māmupāgataḥ
hā putrā māṃ parityajya pitaraṃ duḥkhasāgare
ityādi vilapantaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tau bhrātarau tadā
jīvantīṃ vā mṛtāṃ vā.pi vaddhvā neṣyāva āśu vai
ciraṃ yuddhvā śaraistatra rathaṃ sūtaṃ śarāsanam
tasyā jaghāna tāvat sā prāharanmūrghni sāyakaiḥ
chittvā triśūlaṃ bhallena śiro daityasya pātayata
dvāśabdaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā samunnamya ca bāladhim
taṃ dṛṣṭvā virujaṃ daityaṃ bhairavāṇāṃ bhayaṅkaram
śastradhārāṃ vimuñcan vai kurvan satimirā diśaḥ
alaṃ daityeṣu te devi līlayā bhītidānayā
vāyuneva ca nīhāro naṣṭā māyā ca sarvataḥ
dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ daṇḍinī sākruddhā khaḍgena tacchiraḥ
aho māṃ kiṃ vadāmīha śocantaṃ muktabhāvataḥ
diśatyeva parāmbā sā bhāvarūpā hi kāmadhuk
vikramya yudhi jitvemāḥ śaktiḥ prāpsyām āśiṣam
śaraiḥ śirāṃsi kṛttāni gagane yānti vegataḥ
rathaṃ prāpaya me śīghraṃ sārathe śaktivāhinīm
iti pṛṣṭena cājñapto prāha daityena sārathiḥ
na śokaṃ nā'pi bhītiṃ vā lakṣaye tava leśataḥ
emaṃ lokaṃ saśokaṃ vai sabhayaṃ duḥkhamātrakam
tathā'pi kṛpayā devyā māṃ smṛtirno jahāti vai
etayā nihatā yuddhe bhrātaro me sutā api
mayā saha tvamapyāśu tallokaṃ prāpya bhrātṛbhiḥ
antyaṃ ratnamayaṃ mūrghni bhūṣaṇaṃ mukuṭe sthitam
na striyaṃ manye na pumāṃsamapi kvacit
na tvaṃ satkulasambhūtā kulahīneva bhāsi me
anarhāṃ darśane nūnaṃ paśyāmi purataḥ sthitām
āsāditā mayā sadyaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ na pradarśaya
śṛṇu daityeśvara vaco yaduktaṃ te tathaiva tat
na hi me dṛṣṭiviṣayībhūya bhūyo bhavet kvacit
evaṃ niyudhya suciraṃ daityo'strāṇi sasarja ha
atha bhūyo'ndhakaṃ mṛtyūṃ kāmaṃ tripurameva ca
bhītāścā'tha kiṃ bhavedai iti devāśca śaktyaḥ
hataṃ hataṃ tatra daityo bhūyo bhūyaḥ sasarja ha
hataḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭa eva bhaṇḍadaityena yudhyati
yudhyantyeva punaḥ sṛṣṭā netaḥ sādhyamidaṃ hi naḥ
bhavatu satatamasmanmānase nīrajaske viśadavikacavṛttau vāsite vāsanābhiḥ
brahmāṇḍānāṃ śataṃ pañca caiṣāṃ sa hyadhipo'bhavat
tadadya nihate daitye tvayā yudhi maheśvari
evaṃ tvaṣṭrā prārthito'jo devyai vṛttaṃ vyajijñapat
na me hyaviditaṃ sthānaṃ brahmāṇḍāntarbhavet kvacit
tat kathaṃ varṇitaṃ tatra śrīpuraṃ me samīraya
ye tu śrītripurāṃ śaktiṃ vidhinā samupāsate
viṣṇau śive śaktiṣu ca sarvānte paripākataḥ
iti te kathitā rāma lalitāyāḥ kathā śubhā
yo me mārga niradiśadandhasya bhramato yathā
śūnyakūpe bheka iva na svārthamavidaṃ kvacit
tat pṛcchāmi bhavantaṃ yadvaktuṃj tanme samarhasi
kuto va vedanirate na hi syāttasya darśanam
vāsanānāṃ śataṃ citte sañcitaṃ prāṇināṃ pṛthak
na yogyatā tathā'trāpi vinā dīkṣāṃ bhṛgūdbaha
svabuddhyā tu kṛtaṃ karma vidhinā ca samanvitam
puruṣārtho vedavidhau sarvathā na hi vidyate
sannyāsinā tu tyaktavyaṃ sarvaṃ bandhātmanā sthitam
na (hi) tyaktuṃ samucitaṃ brāhmaṇyamiva vai yateḥ
na sādhanaṃ phalaṃ vā'pi pravṛttirvā.pi bhārgava !
tasmāt pūjā tu śakteḥ syāt sarvatra vihitā janaiḥ
pūjayanti pṛthak devaṃ phalaṃ vindanti tattathā
prakāśaśaktihīno vai raviḥ kutra kadā bhāvet
citiśaktyā parityaktaṃ tṛṇaṃ vā'pi kathaṃ bhavet
evaṃ buddhyā tu yat kiñcit tṛṇañca tripurātmakam
vedārthaḥparamo yastu tripuraiva hi sā bhavet
veda eva hi tantraṃ syāttantraṃ vedaḥ prakīrtitam
abhavaṃ muktasandehaḥ kiñcit pṛcchāmi vai punaḥ
tanme samācakṣva guro kṛpayā mayi sevake
tatra śrīcakrarājaṃ vā mūrtiṃ vā'pi sulakṣaṇām
evaṃ yaḥ kurute loke sa vasecchrīpurā'ntare
na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ sāyujyaṃ vindate kramāt
pūjayet sthāvaraṃ ckraṃ mūrtiṃ vā bhaktipūrvakam
tasyāṃ'śabhūtāḥ sarvā vai tasmāt pūjyā yathāvidhī
mucyate nā'sti sandeha ityāha bhagavān śivaḥ
sataṇḍulaṃ phalaṃ pūrṇa pātrañcā'pi mukhe nyaset
daśadikṣu ca dikpālān śṛṅkhalāsu caturṣu ca
ante daśāṃ'śato banhau pāyasena hūnet kramāt
atha vā devatāsthāne paricaryāṃ samācare tu
sa dehānte vaidrume tu prākāre nivaseściram
evamatra yathā yo yaḥ sevāṃ kuryāttu mandire
sarvaṃ dānaṃ tena dattaṃ tena yajñāstathā kṛtāḥ
tripurā'pi ca tatkarmasakṛśaṃ nā'sti vai phalam
tasya puṇyamananto'pi na śaktaḥ kathane kvacit
pūjāṃ vā'pi cirocchinnāṃ pravartayati yaḥ punaḥ
sā māhātmayaśrutimṛte yato na bhavati kvacit
bhakyā vinā paraṃ śreyaḥ kathaṃ syāddevatā parā
tathā bhaktiṃ vinā jñānaṃ phalaṃ na janayet kvacit
tasmādbhaktivihīnasya na kvacit syād dhṛtiḥ kvacit
amṛtāḥ śivamukhyāḥ syuḥ sā mātā tripuraiva hṛīm
